intro.text: Several things that you can do in the Trust Framework portal can also be done via API — managing organisations, software statements, authorisation servers, certificates, and contacts.
The API uses mTLS for all authenticated requests. A valid transport certificate registered in the Trust Framework is required.

blocks.text: As per the Trust Framework, the API is powered by Raidiam and the official documentation can be found at raidiam.com/developers/docs/apis.
